query:
SELECT DISTINCT reached.user_id AS "user_id!"
        FROM (
            SELECT unnest($1::text[]) AS user_id

            UNION ALL

            SELECT cp.user_id
            FROM comms_channel_participants cp
            WHERE cp.left_at IS NULL AND cp.channel_id = ANY($2::uuid[])

            UNION ALL

            SELECT tu.user_id
            FROM team_user tu
            WHERE tu.team_id = ANY($3::uuid[])
        ) AS reached
